why: Each vendor reads ONLY its own discovery path, so a skill absent from a path is invisible to that agent — the paths are not shared.

Measured 2026-08-12 on ai_darkhero before this registry existed: .cursor reached 38/40 canon skills, .claude 4/40, .agents 4/40. 36 canon skills were unreachable by the EXECUTING seat anywhere on the machine while the reviewing seat could see them. That is executor-judge starvation, not a policy.

The starvation was a cost defence, not a design: subset was hardcoded in three places in fleet-skill-sync.py and full copies would have tripled 189 physical skill folders. link_mode=junction removes the cost, so subset can be full everywhere.

turn_refresh.activation_proof: actual agent/pre-step event bound to the live session and prompt; plugin loading alone is readiness

turn_refresh.hook_trust_boundary: Non-managed changed hooks remain UNKNOWN until the host executes the exact trusted definition; configuration read-back or a synthetic probe is insufficient.
turn_refresh.activation_proof: actual UserPromptSubmit event receipt bound to the live session and prompt

subset_semantics.full: the per-root set computed by fleet-skill-sync._skills_for_root() — REQUIRED + seat extras + path-prefix extras
subset_semantics.entrypoints: the cross-tool discovery entrypoints only (the pre-2026-08-12 behaviour of .claude, and of .agents while that surface existed)

link_mode_semantics.junction: Windows directory junction to canonical_source/<skill>. One referent per machine, so a canon edit is live on every surface with no copy step and no drift window.
link_mode_semantics.copy: physical copy via _copy_skill_tree — the pre-2026-08-12 behaviour, kept for non-NTFS or non-Windows nodes

junction_facts_measured.api: _winapi.CreateJunction — no admin right needed, ~0.38ms per link, no subprocess
junction_facts_measured.os_path_islink: False on junctions — any guard using islink() MISSES them; use os.path.isjunction (3.12+)
junction_facts_measured.os_walk: DOES traverse into a junction, so tree-hash and verify still see skill content through the link

delete_safety_probe.claim: every routine cleanup path removes the LINK and leaves canon alive

junction_facts_measured.git_status_traverses: git status -uall reports files THROUGH the junction as untracked, so every seat repo carrying a surface MUST gitignore the surface dirs or the whole canon gets absorbed into that repo

vendor_neutrality_proof.claim: onboarding a future vendor is a data-only edit to this file — zero lines of engine code
vendor_neutrality_proof.method: appended a synthetic surface {key: probe, path: [.probe-vendor, skills]} plus its gitignore_required entry, changed nothing else, then ran the normal deploy/verify engines

measured.skill_surface.SURFACES: picked up the third surface with no code change
measured.fleet-skill-sync deploy --agent ai_darkh: 37/37 canon skills materialised under .probe-vendor/skills, all 37 junctions resolving to canonical_source
measured.fleet-skill-sync verify: FAIL missing=36 while only fames was deployed, OK after full deploy — the gate is surface-driven, not vendor-hardcoded
measured.gitignore: deploy wrote the new rule, so git status showed nothing for .probe-vendor — the untracking guarantee extends to a new vendor automatically
measured.revert: removing the surface dir left canon file count unchanged (107 before and after); lexicon-sync issues=0 and test_fames_stack passed

vendor_neutrality_proof.rule: a new AI vendor is onboarded HERE. Never by adding a provider path literal to an engine.

non_canon_rule.rule: a surface dir whose name is NOT in canonical_source stays physical and is never junctioned or deleted
non_canon_rule.why: measured 2026-08-12: 29 such skills are legitimate single-seat development, each present in exactly one seat and domain-bound. They are promotion candidates, not drift.

quarantine_on_replace.rule: before a physical canon-named dir is replaced by a junction, it is quarantined if its tree differs from canon; identical trees are removed outright
quarantine_on_replace.why: reversibility — a physical surface dir may hold an un-promoted local edit, and the fleet convention is quarantine, never hard delete

consumers: _skill/engines/fleet-skill-sync.py — SKILL_DIRS / DISCOVERY_ENTRYPOINTS now load from here
_skill/fleet-skills/fames/scripts/fames_fleet.py — _surfaces() drives install/verify-host targets; unreadable registry yields no targets and fails closed without provider-specific fallback
